messages:
marta: Heads-up — after the runtime rollout this morning we're seeing a sustained ~45% tokens/sec drop on a subset of pods. It looks like continuous-batcher wakeups are stalling at startup and selected kernels fall back to the memcpy path a lot. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-17T15:23:45Z] scheduler: batcher_wake(ms)=1200 queue_len=1 selected_kernel=memcpy_fallback
[2026-03-17T15:23:45Z] kvcache: hit_rate=0.04 miss=1234
[2026-03-17T15:23:46Z] perf: tokens/s down 52% vs baseline
```
marta: This is affecting both hosted and a few Dedicated clusters (low traffic canaries). Not seeing obvious OOMs or GPU errors.
ci-bot: PERF ALERT — perf/inference-suite/tokenrate dropped 47% on branch `main` after merge commit bc12345 (see: https://ci.redwood/12345)
ashley: ok I'm starting a local bisect. initial hunch: batching window tweak from last PR could alter coalescing and kernel choice.
omar: commit bc12345 also changed fastpath kernel scoring: it increases min_batch_window_ms from 8 -> 28 and added a `prefer_fastpath` flag flip. small batches now keep waiting longer, which seems counterintuitive.
ashley: bisect result (fast):
```
$ git bisect start -- perf/regression
bisect hits commit bc12345
good commit aa9f1c2
-> culprit: bc12345 "batching: increase min_batch_window and flip prefer_fastpath"
```
ashley: when I force the old window locally (8ms) token/sec returns to baseline within noise.
derek: hold rollout? we should pause the main rollout and revert this specific change or ship a hotfix that restores prior window.
lucy: putting a canary hold on the hosted rollout now (:lock:). I'll open an incident and notify infra.
omar: additional detail: kernel selector now treats batches < 16 tokens as slowpath and triggers memcpy kernels because kvcache prefetch decision is delayed by the longer window. so the small-startup inference (prefix heavy) loses KV HSR, then memcopy path = slower.
marta: is there an easy config override we can flip in prod to mitigate while we prepare a revert?
ashley: yes — runtime config `batcher.min_batch_window_ms` is readable from configmap; setting back to 8ms fixes coalescing patterns. I can send a patch to the control plane to change for affected clusters.
derek: can we add a perf CI test that simulates small-batch startup patterns? this slipped because perf suite didn't include low-concurrency startup workloads.
ci-bot: CI failure link: https://ci.redwood/12345/output — shows kernel fallback counts spike by 6x on bc12345
ashley: I'll prepare a rollback PR for bc12345 and also a targeted hotfix to set min_batch_window_ms=8 by default; will request urgent review.
lucy: I'll coordinate canary rollback and delay further rollouts until we verify token/sec recovery. tagging SRE oncall.
marta: action items: 1) pause rollout (lucy) 2) apply config override to affected clusters (ashley) 3) open revert PR for bc12345 (ashley) 4) add perf regression test for startup small-batch workload (derek) 5) follow-up to tune kernel selector to respect kvcache prefetch for early-life batches (omar)
ashley: noted, creating PRs and posting links in this thread. thanks everyone, will report back with timestamps when changes are applied. :thumbsup:
